entry.title: The CLA handles Beijing's toughest traffic | Tech Explained

media:group.media:title: The CLA handles Beijing's toughest traffic | Tech Explained
media:group.media:description:
Intersections, roundabouts, e-scooters, buses, cyclists and constant movement from every direction… nope, Beijing traffic isn’t for the faint-hearted. 🤯
In this episode of Tech Explained, Rob takes the new Mercedes-Benz CLA through the megacity’s traffic jungle to explore MB.DRIVE ASSIST PRO with Navigation Guided Assist.
Developed for China with Mercedes-Benz ADAS partner Momenta, the system combines navigation with advanced SAE-Level 2 assistance to support the driver through demanding urban scenarios – from dense traffic to merges, toll gates and complex turns.
Watch now to see how the CLA handles it in the middle of one of the world’s most complex city driving environments.

entry.title: We crashed two real CLA models into each other. Here’s why.

media:group.media:title: We crashed two real CLA models into each other. Here’s why.
media:group.media:description:
What happens when two real cars meet in a T-bone crash?
We staged the world’s first high-speed intersection crash test with two moving vehicles: a CLA Shooting Brake with an electrified combustion engine struck the driver’s side of an all-electric CLA, with both vehicles travelling at 56 km/h. At this speed, the impact represents a very severe intersection collision, near the upper end of speeds typically seen in real-world junction accidents In everyday driving, the CLA’s active safety systems can help prevent this kind of crash or mitigate its severity.
So, how did the cars perform? The dummy readings and other data indicate that all safety systems worked as intended for the one reason: to keep your occupants as safe as possible.
The electric CLA’s battery cells remained protected within their dedicated survival space. However, did you know that this type of car-to-car T-bone impact test isn’t required by any regulation or standard safety rating? Go behind the scenes of the test to see how real-world accident research, digital simulation and physical crash testing come together in our approach to real-life safety.

entry.title: THE 140 FESTIVAL | Homecoming of the S-Class World Tour & Mercedes-AMG GT SUV World Premiere

media:group.media:title: THE 140 FESTIVAL | Homecoming of the S-Class World Tour & Mercedes-AMG GT SUV World Premiere
media:group.media:description:
The “140 Places Tour” will end where it began: at the Mercedes-Benz Museum in Stuttgart.
After more than 65,000 kilometres across 55 countries and six continents, Bertha, Carl and Gottlieb have returned home. The journey of the three S-Class vehicles around the world culminated at the Mercedes-Benz Museum in Stuttgart with THE 140 FESTIVAL, celebrating 140 Years of Innovation.
Relive the highlights of this extraordinary celebration, including the homecoming of the S-Class world tour, a convoy of 140 historic and current Mercedes-Benz vehicles, and the world premiere of the all-new Mercedes-AMG GT SUV
Die Tour 140 YEARS. 140 PLACES. endet dort, wo sie begann: am Mercedes-Benz Museum in Stuttgart.
Nach mehr als 65.000 Kilometern durch 55 Länder auf sechs Kontinenten sind Bertha, Carl und Gottlieb wieder zu Hause angekommen. Die Reise der drei S-Klassen rund um die Welt fand ihren Höhepunkt beim THE 140 FESTIVAL am Mercedes-Benz Museum in Stuttgart und markierte einen besonderen Moment im Jubiläumsjahr „140 Years of Innovation“.
Erleben Sie die Highlights dieses außergewöhnlichen Festes noch einmal: die Heimkehr der S-Klassen-Welttour, einen Konvoi aus 140 historischen und aktuellen Mercedes-Benz Fahrzeugen sowie die Weltpremiere des neuen Mercedes-AMG GT SUV
